questions.question: The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said the advisory (A)/ has been withdrawn (B)/ to carry out farther consultations with stakeholders. (C)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said the advisory (A)/ has been withdrawn (B)/ to carry out farther consultations with stakeholders. (C)
questions.solution: 'further' will be used instead of 'farther' because 'further' means 'more' or 'additional' and is commonly used in the context of consultations or discussions. 'Farther' is used in the context of physical distance. The correct sentence will be: "to carry out further consultations with stakeholders."

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . Despite the fact that attempts to provide reservation in jobs for local workers have (A)/ been proven unconstitutional and have been rejected by courts, (B)/ the temptation to pandering to nativist sentiments (C)/ remains among State governments. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Despite the fact that attempts to provide reservation in jobs for local workers have (A)/ been proven unconstitutional and have been rejected by courts, (B)/ the temptation to pandering to nativist sentiments (C)/ remains among State governments. (D)
questions.solution: 'to pander' will be used instead of 'to pandering' because after 'temptation to,' the base form of the verb is required. 'Pandering' is incorrect here as it is in gerund form, while an infinitive ('to' + base verb) is needed. The correct sentence will be: "the temptation to pander to nativist sentiments."

India’s goods exports rose for the third succession month (A)/ this June, growing 2.55% to $35.2 billion. India’s goods exports rose for the third succession month (A)/ this June, growing 2.55% to $35.2 billion. (B)/ Imports grew 5% to $56.2 billion, receding from (C)/ May’s seven-month peak of nearly $62 billion. (D)
questions.solution: 'successive' will be used instead of 'succession' because an adjective is needed here to describe 'month.' 'Succession' is a noun, while 'successive' is an adjective that denotes consecutive occurrences. The correct sentence will be: "India’s goods exports rose for the third successive month."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks . The court's decision to set a ____________ on how ____________ companies should be handled in bankruptcy cases will impact future legal proceedings.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.

The court's decision to set a ____________ on how ____________ companies should be handled in bankruptcy cases will impact future legal proceedings.
questions.solution: 'Precedent' and 'defunct' will be used because "precedent" refers to a decision that sets an example for future cases, and "defunct" means inactive or closed companies. The sentence discusses the court's decision on how defunct companies should be handled in bankruptcy cases, making 'precedent' and 'defunct' the correct choices. Whereas, 'Model' means an ideal example, 'Aspiration' means a goal or ambition, and 'Guide' means a guide or leader, which do not fit in this context.

Therefore, location, time, and quality are no longer considered factors in seeking degree courses or higher education because of online education. C . Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet. D . Its potential advantages involve increased educational access
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It provides a high-quality learning opportunity, improves student outcomes and skills, and expands educational choice options

B. Therefore, location, time, and quality are no longer considered factors in seeking degree courses or higher education because of online education.

C. Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet.

D. Its potential advantages involve increased educational access
questions.solution: Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet. questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level. B. This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm. C. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube. D . When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.

B. This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm.

C. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube.

D. When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer
questions.solution: When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.
